from.slates: The Odds API (74 games pulled, median of books)

how.A: CFB rebuild v4 (desk v3 unblended + program SRS + coach career win% + crowd size; total + in-season tempo) + player usage prior + missing starters; drive-simulator ranges, key-number margin curve (sd 16.2)
how.B: Sharp-weighted devigged market; look-ahead lines (kickoff 4+ days out) trust 44% of a spread gap, later lines 34%. Spread A = look-ahead gap 4+, B = look-ahead 3-4 or later gap 4+; totals: look-ahead unders 4+ lean, the rest pass; moneyline lean at most.

reasons: Kickoff in 0.1 days: game-week line: gaps of 4+ at the close still covered 55% (1,005 bets, 2022-25), so a lean at most
The desk model (v3) is on the same side of the line
Week 8+: Model A's in-season ratings carry the most weight by now
Player usage prior (prop-implied offense): +1.2 pts to SMU, included
